Also known as the Carlin Sword Quest. Go down through Rookgaard's big cave, cross the wolf labyrinth and enter the Minotaur Hell, full of minotaurs, orcs and wolves. At the bottom, three quest boxes hold a {item:Carlin Sword}, a {item:Fishing Rod} and a bag of arrows. It is probably the hardest quest in Rookgaard.

There is a book in Mino Hell that says: The mystical portal is still unstable, so reinforcements from Mintwallin rarely get through here. The royal mage managed to impress the primitive orcs of the area and we can use them as slaves and rune fodder. The trolls surrendered immediately and can be used for minor services. The human base must be destroyed, since more and more of them keep coming. These enemies are not strong, but their numbers can cause trouble. As long as they keep being resurrected in this mystical vortex, even they can ruin our plans. First we have to find out how to destroy the vortex. The mage has locked himself in his quarters and does not want to be disturbed. He has entrusted me with the duty of coordinating all our actions here.
Big cave entrance in Rookgaard (north of the level 2 bridge)
A team is advisable: the monsters come in large numbers.
at least one, to block paths (you can bring them from the Bear Room)
The monsters take down even well-equipped players, mostly because of their numbers. Pull them one at a time and stand where only 1 or 2 can attack you, so you do not lose your shield's defence.
There are a few boxes on the lower floor of the Minotaur Hell, but they are usually far from the stairs. Bring one or two from the {wiki:Bear Room Quest|Bear Room}.
You can leave the orcs with very low health (running away from you) instead of killing them: that way they will not bother you on the way back.
Beware of {creature:Apprentice Sheng}, who may appear in this area.
From the level 2 bridge, go **north** to the big Rookgaard cave and go down.
Map of the full path to the Minotaur Hell

On the 1st underground floor (-1) you will find a {creature:Rat}, some {creature:Troll|Trolls} and maybe {creature:Spider|Spiders}. Cross the cave to the **east** until you find a staircase down and go down.
On floor -2 you may find one or two {creature:Orc|Orcs}. Go **north**; at the first crossing head **northeast** and at the second **northwest**, until you reach another staircase. Go down.

You are in the *Wolf maze*. Follow the path **north**, among many {creature:Wolf|Wolves} and {creature:Orc|Orcs}, until you find yet another staircase. This staircase leads to the {wiki:Minotaur Hell}.
First floor of the Minotaur Hell

When you go down the staircase you will find about 2 {creature:Minotaur|Minotaurs}, 8 {creature:Orc|Orcs} and some {creature:Wolf|Wolves}. Stand in the position **north** of the staircase, where only 2 creatures can attack you. Kill the wolves and orcs first (they die faster) and then the minotaurs.
Without boxes, only two creatures attack you here
If more than 2 creatures attack you at the same time, you lose your shield's defence against the third. Isolate the monsters.
Going down to the quest room

With the floor cleared, go down the staircase to the final room. There are about 5 {creature:Minotaur|Minotaurs} and 3 {creature:Wolf|Wolves}. There are fewer good places to pull them one by one, so use at least one {item:Box|box} to block.
With a box, only two minotaurs can attack you here

With the room cleared, the three quest boxes are just **west** of the stairs, against the **south** walls of the cave. Open them: one has the {item:Carlin Sword}, another the {item:Fishing Rod} and another a bag with 10 {item:Arrow|Arrows} and 4 {item:Poison Arrow|Poison Arrows}.
The quest room and the rewards

Leave the way you came in. If there are many creatures on the floor above, stand **southeast** of the staircase, where only 2 can attack you. There is also a spot well to the **west** of the stairs where only 1 creature can reach you. Then climb up staircase by staircase along the map path in reverse: the wolf maze (-3) to the **south**, floor -2 back through the two crossings and floor -1 to the **west**, until you come out in the big cave north of the level 2 bridge. From there go back **south** to Rookgaard village.
Position for the exit, in case there are many creatures
Here only one creature can reach you
Alternative tactics: cross without clearing the rooms, or kill everything except the minotaurs. Careful: being surrounded by minotaurs in Rookgaard is deadly.
